title: RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development
abstract: arXiv:2610.26826v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Beyond basic tool use and coding skills, effectively incorporating visual references into agentic generation is equally essential for applying AI agents to real-world productivity tasks. We study this crucial capability through webpage development, a practical and readily evaluable setting in which existing benchmarks remain largely idealized: they typically focus on reconstructing visual targets or generating webpages from textual instructions alone, overlooking the more common workflow of developing from visual examples. Specifically, we introduce RefCraft, a benchmark comprising 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks that combine natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages. Agents must selectively interpret and utilize these references while rendering, visually inspecting, and iteratively refining their outputs. translated_title: RefCraft：通过网页开发对视觉参考条件化的智能体生成进行基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.26826v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：除了基本的工具使用和编程技能之外，如何有效地将视觉参考融入智能体生成过程，对于将AI智能体应用于现实世界的生产力任务同样至关重要。我们通过网页开发来研究这一关键能力——这是一个实用且易于评估的场景，但现有基准在此方面大多仍停留在理想化状态：它们通常专注于重建视觉目标或仅根据文本指令生成网页，而忽视了基于视觉示例进行开发这一更为常见的工作流程。具体而言，我们提出了RefCraft，一个包含300个真实多模态网页开发任务的基准，这些任务将自然语言指令与一至五个参考网页的截图相结合。智能体必须在渲染输出时选择性地解读和利用这些参考，同时进行视觉检查并迭代优化其产物。我们使用独立的评估方法来评估所产生的开放式结果。
tldr: 该论文提出了RefCraft基准，包含300个将自然语言指令与参考网页截图相结合的多模态网页开发任务，用于评估智能体选择性地解读视觉参考并迭代优化生成结果的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RefCraft, a benchmark of 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks combining natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages, designed to evaluate agents' ability to selectively interpret visual references and iteratively refine their outputs.
